typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) and heavy weight (font-black) for titles. Keep body highly legible.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/80 border-t border-zinc-800/50 for floating headers and bottom nav.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Thick, rounded-xl or full pill shape. Primary button MUST be #FFE800 with black text. Add active:scale-95 transition.
visual_enhancers.cards: Cardless feed design (edge-to-edge images/video). For UI elements, use bg-zinc-900 with 1px border-zinc-800.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for the 'Sa k ap fè bri 🔥' (Trending) hashtag section to give it an energetic, kinetic feel.
visual_enhancers.overlay: Always use gradient overlays (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/40 to-transparent) on feed images so white text is 100% legible.

layouts.global: Mobile-first social app constraint. If on desktop, constrain the main app view to max-w-md mx-auto with a phone-like aspect ratio (min-h-screen) and dark background.
layouts.feed: Edge-to-edge media using vertical snap scrolling (snap-y snap-mandatory) typical of TikTok/Reels.
layouts.navigation: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile app feel. Never use a hamburger menu. Display Home, Discover, Upload, Leaderboard, Profile icons.
layouts.grids: Use tight bento grids (gap-2 or gap-4) for 'Top 10 Haiti' and category browsers.

motion.transitions: Use specific transforms only. E.g., transition-transform duration-200 ease-out active:scale-95 for buttons.
motion.feed_scroll: Smooth snap scrolling for the main feed.
motion.hover: Hover states must lighten the background slightly. E.g., hover:bg-zinc-800.

components.files: CRITICAL: All components must be written in .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx. Provide the guideline for .js files.
components.buttons: Shadcn Button, override styles to match Primary (#FFE800) and Secondary (zinc-800).
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs for switching between 'Jodi a' (Today) and 'Sa k ap fè bri' (Trending).
components.dialog: Shadcn Dialog for the Participation/Upload flow and Auth flow.

content_guidelines.language: Haitian Creole primary. Examples: 'Antre nan Challenge 🔥', 'Vote pou li ❤️', 'Top 10 Haiti'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has a strong gradient overlay. Use APCA guidelines for high contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans'.
Build the application using standard JavaScript (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Ensure standard HTML input date/select are NOT used; use Shadcn.
Always add data-testid attributes to interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='vote-button').
App must look like a native mobile app but running in the browser (mobile web app).
Implement a fixed bottom navigation bar (Home, Categories, Upload, Leaderboard, Profile).
For the feed, use full-width cards or edge-to-edge images with heavy dark bottom gradients so white text pops.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header; if header is floating, use glassmorphism with border.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
